sources.games: 270 league games since 7.40 (data/heroes/item_stats; 7.41 alone had under 300; the skill build has 130 games of 7.41), win 52.2%, soft support (STRATZ pos4, 2369 games). Under 150 games in any group: build checked against STRATZ pos4, which has only Spirit Vessel (16 min, 23%). Reproduce: python scripts/hero_item_stats.py earth_spirit.
sources.items: No item rule: Spirit Vessel against healing heroes is 39% vs 32% of 36 games, won 64% vs 27% on a handful of games (asked); build from the games.
sources.hero: Valve /datafeed/herodata hero_id 107 (Boulder Smash, Geomagnetic Grip, Magnetize), fetched 2026-11-07.

build_basis: Assembled items bought in 25%+ of the won games, by median minute: ward_dispenser 97% (2), urn_of_shadows 66% (7), magic_wand 67% (8), tranquil_boots 24% (8), diadem 40% (12), spirit_vessel 38% (17), great_famango 28% (22), blink 52% (23), cyclone 29% (23), staff_of_wizardry 57% (23), aether_lens 55% (26), point_booster 23% (27), aghanims_shard 38% (27), ogre_axe 33% (30). Reviewed: Ogre Axe (a part, 33% at 30 min) dropped; Urn of Shadows (66% at 7 min) is the part of Spirit Vessel, under 1000 gold. STRATZ pos4 (2369 games): Spirit Vessel 16 min 23% (won 49%), nothing else.

skills.basis: 130 games since 7.41: maxed earth_spirit_boulder_smash > earth_spirit_rolling_boulder > earth_spirit_geomagnetic_grip 26 (win 61.5%), earth_spirit_rolling_boulder > earth_spirit_geomagnetic_grip > earth_spirit_boulder_smash 24 (win 58.3%), earth_spirit_rolling_boulder > earth_spirit_boulder_smash > earth_spirit_geomagnetic_grip 23 (win 65.2%); talents 10: +150 Rolling Boulder Distance 119/127 (50.4%), -2.0s Boulder Smash Cooldown 8/127 (50.0%); 15: +80 Boulder Smash Damage 43/82 (53.5%), Rolling Boulder Stun Duration 39/82 (71.8%); 20: +30% Magnetize Damage & Duration 24/29 (66.7%), +175% Rolling Boulder Damage from Strength 5/29 (80.0%); 25: Earth Spirit Magnetizes himself 4/5 (75.0%), +250 Geomagnetic Grip Remnant Damage 1/5 (100.0%).

notes.basis: Valve Geomagnetic Grip (fetched 2026-11-07): enemies struck by the pulled remnant or ally are silenced for 2.3-3.5 s (13 s cooldown, 1000-1300 range to a remnant); the escape group is the escapes a silence stops (draft_analysis.ESCAPES).

reason.en: {enemy} runs away with spells: Geomagnetic Grip silences the enemies the pulled remnant strikes for up to 3.5 s, so pull one through them before they cast it
